==Overview== 
[[File:Elemental Type Chart.png|100px|thumb|left|Elemental type chart.]] The Lightning type is one of the five elemental types found in Clash of Critters.

[[Tatari|Tataris]] and [[Zobos]] of the Lightning type are weak to [[Rock]].

They are also super effective against [[Water]].
